config._comment_user: Least-privileged replication user from postgres/init.sql (REPLICATION + SELECT); not a superuser
config._comment_password: Resolved by the Connect worker from the mounted secret file (DirectoryConfigProvider); never stored in the config
config.plugin.name: pgoutput
config.publication.name: cdc_publication
config.slot.name: debezium_slot
config._comment_include: Every ecommerce table except pipeline/infra tables; new business tables are picked up without editing this file
config._comment_identity: REPLICA IDENTITY is set in postgres/init.sql by the table owner: FULL for state tables, DEFAULT for append-only ones
config._comment_converters: R9: values are registered in the Schema Registry (subject <topic>-value, BACKWARD compatibility); an incompatible change fails the task (errors.tolerance none) and ConnectorNotRunning fires. Keys stay plain JSON
config._comment_pii: Personal data is hashed (salted SHA-256) before it leaves PostgreSQL: Kafka and the warehouse can still join and count buyers but never see names, emails, phones or street addresses. The salt is PII_SALT from .env, filled in by debezium/register.sh or the Control Center on register
config._comment_outbox: Outbox rows become domain events on events.<aggregatetype>; other tables pass through untouched
config._comment_outbox_payload: Payload kept as a JSON string: event types differ in shape, and one schema per events.* topic must stay compatible
config._comment_tombstones: No tombstones: nothing is log-compacted, and a null message would stop ClickHouse ingestion
config.heartbeat.action.query: INSERT INTO ecommerce.cdc_heartbeat (id,ts) VALUES (1,NOW()) ON CONFLICT (id) DO UPDATE SET ts = NOW()
config._comment_errors: Fail fast: a change that cannot be converted stops the task (and is alerted on) instead of being dropped
config._comment_throughput: R10: larger batches and queue for 11.11 bursts (the queue is capped in bytes so it cannot eat the heap), shorter poll for lag; lz4 costs far less CPU than gzip and ClickHouse reads it
